title: A Cartesian Grid Method for Advection-Diffusion Equations with Robin Boundary Conditions on Moving Domains
summary: We develop a Cartesian grid method for advection--diffusion equations with Robin boundary conditions on moving domains. The moving-domain problem is reformulated as an interface problem on a box, with an unknown density introduced on the moving interface to enforce the Robin condition. The bulk equation is discretized by a cell-centered finite-difference scheme on the Cartesian grid, while interface corrections are obtained from local problems in a narrow band around the interface.
